name: Katherine Earle Yanes
tagline: Top rated White Collar Crimes attorney in Tampa, Florida
about: Katherine Earle Yanes is an attorney providing legal services covering Criminal Defense: White Collar, Appellate and Criminal Defense.

Katherine Yanes, who practices law in Tampa, Florida, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at Stetson University College of Law. She graduated in 1997. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1998.
